requirements.text: Update the existing change record to reflect all affected configuration items
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM change WHERE change_id = 'CHG_001' AND short_description LIKE '%SRV-LNX-4421%'
requirements.source: Existing Change Updated with Additional CI
assumptions: CHG0000001 is CHG_001 in the seed (status scheduled, configuration_item CI_001 = SAP-DB-01, serial SRV-ORC-9981)
the serial SRV-LNX-4421 is CI_002, SAP-APP-01 (Application Server), status in_use
the change table has one configuration_item column and no change-to-CI link table, so the added CI is recorded by naming its serial in short_description, as the benchmark check tests
which field names the added CI is not fixed by request or policy; kept from the benchmark check, and the request names the server by its serial

requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM change WHERE change_id = 'CHG_001' AND configuration_item = 'CI_001'
assumptions: 'all affected configuration items' includes the originally listed CI_001 (SAP-DB-01); overwriting the single configuration_item column with CI_002 would drop it, so the seed value must stay

requirements.text: progress it to the appropriate post-implementation state so it can be finalized without delays
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM change WHERE change_id = 'CHG_001' AND status = 'review'
requirements.source: Change Moved Out of Implementation Phase
assumptions: the policy's change_request.status enumeration runs implement -> review -> closed; the post-implementation state that leaves finalisation still to do is review
closed would finalise the record, which the request leaves for later ('so it can be finalized'), so closed is not accepted
seed status is scheduled; the request says the implementation completed, so the record lands on review

requirements.text: Do not create any new change records
assumptions: the request forbids new change records; the seed holds 25 change rows (highest CHG_025) and the count must not grow

notes: Merged from two passes that agree on every requirement (the serial SRV-LNX-4421 named in CHG_001's short_description, CHG_001 moved to review, CI_001 kept in its configuration_item column, no new change rows), every value and both dispositions (kept). disagreement: selector of the no-new-change stay: one pass writes it in words ('every row of change'), the other as the WHERE clause 1 = 1; chose 1 = 1 because a selector is a WHERE clause and the count is the same (25). disagreement: texts: one pass adds parentheticals to the request's words on the two configuration-item requirements; kept the request's own words. The acting user USER_039 (Karen Watkins) is an active admin in the seed, which the policy grants full CRUD on all tables, so no role gate applies. The change table carries a single configuration_item column, so the extra CI can only be reflected in text; the benchmark's LIKE on the serial is kept as the test. close_code and close_notes are not required: the request stops short of finalising the change.
